invariants.rationale: result is either 0 or the minimum height returned by style.hScrollKnob or style.hScroll, both of which are non-negative or zero.
The only case where result is 0 occurs if scrollX is false.
If scrollX is true and result is zero, then both hScrollKnob and hScroll must be null.

invariants.expression: (style.hScroll == null && style.hScrollKnob == null) || result >= (style.hScrollKnob != null ? style.hScrollKnob.getMinHeight() : 0)
invariants.rationale: If either knob is present, result will be at least as large as hScrollKnob's min height, unless both are null.

invariants.expression: (style.hScroll == null && style.hScrollKnob == null) || result >= (style.hScroll != null ? style.hScroll.getMinHeight() : 0)
invariants.rationale: If either scroll is present, result will be at least as large as hScroll's min height, unless both are null.
